raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.6.3"
  # see github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge.github.io/issues/1059 for naming discussion

package:
  name: pytorch_cluster
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/t/torch_cluster/torch_cluster-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 78d5a930a5bbd0d8788df8c6d66addd68d6dd292fe3edb401e3dacba26308152

build:
  number: 15
  skip:
    - win

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cuda') if cuda_compiler_version != "None" }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pytorch
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - pytorch * cuda*
          else:
            - pytorch * cpu*
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - pytorch
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - pytorch * cuda*
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
      else:
        - pytorch * cpu*
    - setuptools
    - pytest-runner
    - scipy
  run:
    - python
    - scipy
    - pytest
    - pytest-cov
  run_constraints:
    # additional run constraint to the one from the (version-only) run_export;
    # constraining the CPU builds to CPU pytorch isn't 100% necessary, but cleaner
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - pytorch * cuda*
      else:
        - pytorch * cpu*

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - torch_cluster

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/rusty1s/pytorch_cluster
  summary: PyTorch Extension Library of Optimized Graph Cluster Algorithms
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/rusty1s/pytorch_cluster

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mxr-conda
    - dsangillo
    - pstjohn
    - eunos-1128
